card.name: Small words in religious and social writing
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as the, his, be, United and an apostrophe, in religious, church and social-politics prose (not drug labels). They sit inside a phrase before a likely noun like States, Church, life or glory.

modes.label: Article in set phrases
modes.description: The word the or United inside a fixed place or institution name.
modes.example: The Other America: Poverty in<< the>> United States.

modes.label: Possessive or pronoun in theology
modes.description: His or an apostrophe after Jesus or a verb, before an abstract noun like glory or life.
modes.example: And he invites us to share<< his>> glory with him.

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in church and social-history writing, just before a name or abstract noun.
evidence: The Other America: Poverty in<< the>> United States.
He is a retired minister in the<< United>> Methodist Church.
No one took<< his>> life from him.
